description.zh: 设置查询的参数，当值为`FixCmd`时只返回`FixCmd`的结果，其余字段不返回
description.en: The parameter whose value that you want to query. Fox example, if the value is `FixCmd`, only the `FixCmd` parameter is returned.
The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 扫描结果列表每页展示数
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page.
The ID of the image repository.
The ID of the security scan task.

description.zh:
漏洞类型，取值：

- `cve`：镜像系统漏洞
- `sca`：镜像应用漏洞
description.en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

*   `cve`: image system vulnerability
*   `sca`: image application vulnerability

description.zh:
扫描漏洞等级，取值：

- `High`：高危

- `Medium`：中危

- `Low`：低危

- `Unknown`：未知
description.en:
The severity of the vulnerability. Valid values:

*   `High`
*   `Medium`
*   `Low`
*   `Unknown`
The name of the image tag.

description.zh: 扫描模糊查询词，支持按照CVE名称模糊查询
description.en: The keyword for fuzzy search used in scanning. The value can be a CVE name.

title.zh: 获取镜像版本扫描结果列表
